text: Celebrated my grandmas 80th birthday with 20 family members and the food was amazing!!!! Service was great and the food was GREAT!! Even during covid and social distancing they accommodated us without any issues. Food was very fresh and plentiful. Waiters were attentive, and nice. Hardly any wait for the food dishes came out back to back and everything was great. If your in the area this place is a MUST!

The food was delicious but THE SERVICE AND THE FEMALE MANAGER ON DUTY WAS HORRIBLE. She did not ask the amount to be charged on each card before running our credit cards. She threw the folders with the cards on the table and said, "y'all give them out." Then she LIED and said loudly to my son's friend that his card declined, which was a bold faced lie, then turned around and asked if she could charge his card for additional monies. She NEVER apologized for her gross negligence and was as unprofessional as they come. This was my second time there but will not return. We had to wave our hands several times to get someone's attention to even refill our water glasses. Food is good but not enough to make me go back.

This will be a dining  experience unlike any other. No cell phones and large table seating. You get to interact with stranger as well as your family. The food is served family style and is amazing. The side dishes are just as good as the main dishes with many different options. If you are in the Nashville area this is a must try. Will come again!

NO MASKS WORN HERE BY ANY EMPLOYEES ! ! !  

what's the matter with you Gyro King ?
There's a worldwide pandemic going on You need to do your part.

We went there to eat dinner a couple of weeks ago.  The server made a few suggestions and we were very impressed.  The food was delicious.  The butter panneer, the manchurian chicken and the chicken biryani were soooo good!!!  Definitely will go back soon.

Have been to Mellow Mushroom many times.  Food has always been very good.  The past 3 visits we have been seated in the bar area.  Every time it has been very loud and the service isn't as good as in the dining room areas.  The host staff should really ask before they start walking you to a table if you want to be seated in the bar area.  Last night was a particularly annoying experience.  There were several younger ladies seated at the bar that I suspect are current or past employees of the restaurant.  The bar tender with long dreadlocked hair spent a lot of time flirting with these ladies. The issue was that his voice was so loud that sitting right across the aisle from the bar it was difficult to have a conversation without having to raise your voice.  Also,  several other wait staff knew these ladies and were hanging out in the walkway right next to our table talking and obviously flirting with them.  Management should really find out if their customers are there for a dining or a bar scene.
Great service and the food was excellent.  We had the Tri-Tip Special and Half Rack of Ribs.  Ribs were amazing meat fell right off the bones.  Will definately go back.

Went here for lunch and it was fabulous. The pineapple cilantro margarita was amazing. The different folks in our party also tried the choriqueso, street tacos, mole and the chimichanga. Everything was delicious. The server was also extremely attentive and quick to keep our drinks and chips filled. I highly recommend. Oh, and don't forget to don a sombrero and hop in the saddle for a great photo before you leave!

Wonderful outdoor dining spot in University City. Reasonably-priced menu to suit anyone's tastes. Chicken tenders and fries were tasty. Beer was excellent. Staff are very safety-conscious, but still friendly. Bonus was the live music! Lots of heat lamps kept us comfortable all evening.

Very good little spot on a funky corner with a media address.  A very good cheese steak.  I had a tough time scoring it.  It's on the cuspis of very good pizza place / nice little restaurant.  A very good standard Cheesesteak / fancy place decadent cheesesteak.  I got the roll toasted.  You could also get it scooped. I went with the provolone cheese.  They offered several choices sauces to add to your cheesesteak. I kept mine dry.  Flirted with the idea of putting salsa on it, briefly.  Very good Cheesesteak and my cousin has gotten their pizza and he likes the pizza very much.

It's very rare that you have a perfect dining experience, but at Estella, we had just that. The space is smaller than expected, but you can take your meal in The Jesse, where they have large wood tables, or if it's summertime, you can dine on the patio. We arrived around 4:30 for any early dinner though, so there was plenty of room to dine comfortably at the counter, where you can see the chefs prepare your food. 

We started with a mezcal flight, that we asked the cashier to choose for us. The flight comes with plenty of accoutrements, and they walk you through the best way to taste the mezcal, including house pickled radishes and worm salt. 

For dinner, I started with a seasonal salad of fried squash, grapefruit, and shaved hazelnuts. The squash was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, pairing perfectly with the tangy grapefruit and hazelnuts. 

I chose the smoked mushroom, carnitas, and short rib tacos. Each one had a uniquely rich and well balanced flavor with all of the house made ingredients having a well thought out and delicious roll in the flavor profile all the way down to the tortillas. And the tacos, while on the pricier side were FILLED with tons of meat and toppings. 

Overall I was so highly impressed with our dining experience all the way down to the extremely friendly and helpful staff...

This place doesn't even seem like fast food.  I'm a vegetarian and since they got the beyond meat tacos on their menu I go there often.  Also the lady who works the drive-thru at nights is always so incredibly kind and nice.  Next time I am there I will ask for her name to update this review.  She has an amazing customer service attitude.

This place is great. I've tried several of the sandwiches - panini, cold sandwiches, and breakfast sandwiches, and they are all delicious. The fries are always fresh and crispy. A nice beer selection, and the place itself is always clean and well-organized, with a little grocery section in there too. And everyone who works there is so nice.

I've been to The Cheesecake Factory multiple times. After many times of coming here I've realized it's just ok. I'm sure I'll return because if family and friends who don't live close to one, they always want to experience "The Cheesecake Factory".   

Today I went with the Louisiana Chicken Pasta for my entree. When the server brought out the dish it was only Parmesan Crusted Chicken and pasta. The menu calls for Parmesan Crusted Chicken Served Over Pasta with Mushrooms, Peppers and Onions in a Spicy New Orleans Sauce. Yea, that's a lot of ingredients left out. The server returned the dish and corrected it. The dish was good after the adding the correct ingredients.  It appeared the table behind me was having issues with their meal also. I don't usually give restaurants a hard time with mistakes but the manager was not apologetic. He saw what was happening but never came to the table to apologize at all. IMO good customer service will make up for bad food or mistakes. 

So I have a few pros and cons. 

Pros: 
-Family friendly 
-Decent cheesecake 
-Food is consistent in taste 
-Adult beverages are good 
-Large portions 
-Good appetizers 

Cons: 
-LOUD restaurant not intimate
-Menu has a huge selection. Sometimes it makes it hard to make a decision. 
-Seating is too close. When people walk by your table they seem to be right in your plate. 
-The waiting area is entirely too small. Half the time you don't know if people are waiting to get on the list for a table, in line to get
Menu is large for a coffee shop. The Julie bagel sandwich and Hummingbird coffee were both very tasty.
A must go to when in New Orleans. THE BEST bread pudding.  Also love the BBQ shrimp sandwich.

This used to be a great place to have a sandwich and french fries very disappointed tonight. French fries were not cooked, and the sandwich was mediocre at best. Very disappointing!!! We will not be returning!
The absolute best food I've had in the Bucks County/North East Philly area. There was not a single thing I didn't like. Get yourself to this place. You won't regret it.

Was so excited to try this place. Menu looked really good and they are Cubs fans!

Waitress took our order, promptly brought us refills, even tho we didn't need them.

Appetizer came with our meal...  waitress never came back.  No one checked on us.  Finally some lady in a MJ 45 jersey took our trash, and got my wife a Togo box.  Finally had to ask another lady for our bill after waiting forever

Food was just ok, nothing to rave about.  Ale is 100x better.  Service blew.  Won't be back

Can we just agree that nobody does cafes like the Aussies do? 

What a delight! 

The atmosphere is bright and airy and somehow cozy at the same time. 

The food is fresh and nearly everything can be made gluten-free (thank heavens!). 

The service was lovely as well. 

This would be a great place to have a coffee or lunch meeting, or just to go study. 

I will definitely be back!

This is my favorite watering hole. The staff are always friendly (and the ones who aren't don't last long) and the food is always top-notch. Very mellow vibe.

The Yeti mugs are a nice touch--I know I never have a problem getting my money's worth.

Beware corrupt business practices and shady servers. 

Having enjoyed a previous visit to City Winery in my hometown of NYC, I was enthusiastic about attending the Nashville location, especially since the evening's event was to benefit survivors of the recent tornado. 

We should've stayed home.

The place was freezing and our food was middling. The bottle of wine we ordered was good, but not worth its almost 50% markup we noticed once our bill arrived. Perplexed, we were naturally inclined to ask our server for assistance. When we finally got his attention (after watching him see - then breeze past the "signaling card" on our table) he informed us that bottle prices aren't listed on the menu (although rates "by the glass" and per "carafe" were clearly marked (see reference pic). He told us he was "supposed to inform [us] of them, but didn't," and that we were his second table to experience the same "phenomenon".

When we asked if he could help remedy the issue, he offered us a pathetic discount that was almost as insulting as CW's obvious bait & switch pricing.

Bummer. Won't return to any location.

Really great coffee but SOUR shots consistently. Please fix! If you don't care about espresso, great coffee shop.

They have this "Everything" croissant in the style of an everything bagel, with goat cheese in the middle, really really good.

Oysters, oysters Rockefeller, crab and fried goodness. Expect to wait in line, but it's worth it. A gem in the Garden District, where you can't miss on restaurants and bars. It's simple southern food here. A must in NOLA.

Loved the green smoothie and other healthy options. Easy to find location. Great options for kids and adults. I didn't realize this was a chain restaurant but now that I know I will be looking for more First watch locations.

I am glad I tried this place.  I got the green curry and spicy eggplant.  Both dishes were right on.  Very tasty.

Some comparisons of green curry:
Chibaa's green curry is a bit too sweet for me
Tahi Kuu's green curry is a bit too sweet for me
Bala Thai Bistro's green curry is too salty
Chiangmai's green curry is too waterly

Phu Fha's green curry is just right for me.   I will be back for more!

Very disappointed in the sushi.  The eel sauce did not taste anything like eel sauce. Tried to substitute with teriyaki sauce and it was just as bad. Poorly made sushi as they were falling apart and the fish didn't taste like fish.  I can't believe they are rated above 3 stars! Also they are sneaky about charging you extra.  Check you bill before you pay!
I got the salmon poke bowl. It was extremely dry and unflavorful. There was far too much rice and not enough salmon. Would not recommend.

This spot was amazing, came up for an appointment and figured I would stop by. Had the lamb gyro with seasoned fries, slightly sweetened mint tea and baklava. The experience was perfect and I look forward to returning in the future as I am moving to the area.

We met some friends for dinner and the entire experience was amazing! Tyler was our server and he was great! I had the shrimp scampi and loved it! The sauce was delicious and the asparagus and potatoes were cooked perfectly! My friend also got the scampi. We told Tyler that we loved our dinner and he suggested ordering the rice as a side next time. A few minutes later he brought out a plate of rice for us to share! Not only was the food amazing but the service was perfect which makes for a great experience. We were seated on the patio and it was a cold night but we were near a heater and they had blankets for anyone who wanted them. We will definitely return!
I cannot say enough about my new favorite Mexican joint. Tried brunch for the first time today, so AMAZING! Friendly staff, consistently quality food and drinks!
My FAVORITE sushi spot in Boise! The staff is always friendly, and I love all the options available for the AYCE! I ordered their AYCE take out special and was impressed! Great as always

Best Mexican in the area! We love everything we get! I always get the jims nachos over chips or rice l but my husband tries it all and loves everything he gets! We both love the mango margarita as well!

Very standard all you can eat sushi and hibachi buffet. 

- All the typical standard rolls (spicy tuna, salmon, etc). 
Speciality rolls- nice variety 

Nigiri, comes in 2 piece portions. Salomon and escolar nigiri was very fresh.

My partner had the general t's chicken. I had a bite, it was a little underwhelming. His steak and shrimp hibachi was pretty.

The service itself from our waitress was great, however, once we were seated it took about 10-15 minutes to receive initial service. We were seated, and kind of forgotten about (it seemed). Once we were served she was very attentive and made our experience good.

It was packed for lunch service on a Saturday, so perhaps they were understaffed or over capacity.

All in all, a good experience.

Been here a handful of times..  the food is good, but the service can be frustrating. The young ladies serving have been sweet, but there is a gentleman (with big hair, and a big attitude) who is kind of obnoxious and rude to guests. Seen him act out quite a few times.. The servers all work together as well, so at times they don't come to your table often, or they come too many times asking the same questions, yet its a different person every time. There needs to be some communication between servers if you are serving this style. Now the food.. The rotisserie chicken banh mi is really flavorful with nice crispy bread, and their pho is good too. The Vietnamese iced coffee is the best thing, it tastes like velvety chocolate, its rich and creamy. I really enjoy the buc loc lac entree, its very tender sautéed filet and peppers over a delicious salad, served with rice. But they don't always have it when i go which is disappointing. I did not care for their wings which I've been hearing lots about, too much fat and kind of chewy, none of the crunch i was expecting. My partner and i thought they had a foul odor that i could not get over. I cant tell if its honey and fish sauce? It was kind of sour.. maybe tamarind? Usually i enjoy all of those things, but it just was not for me this time. Also they never have desserts, and I've asked every single time, again another disappointment.
This place is amazing & a must stop in Tucson. The Toritos are a favorite & I'll come here just for them anytime we're in town.

Service was good, but food was horrible.  The chicken Alfredo was swimming in way too much sauce. The Puccetti salad was a favorite of mine when they had a restaurant in Birmingham.  However, the chicken in the salad tonight looked like it came from a can of Chicken from the Sea. It ruined the salad.  Normally, there would be chunks of chicken breast tossed in dressing.  This was no where close to the salad that I have missed.
Food was so tasty! The staff was super friendly. Relaxed but cozy atmosphere. No complaints!

Sloooooowwww Service.

Waited at least 30 minutes for our food, then when it was brought out the waiter brought me the wrong dish. He tried to convince me to eat the dish he brought out. After our meal, it took about an hour to bring out our checks.

Food was bland, and they were out of cheese curds. Cooler was broke as well so there was no cold beer. 

Not worth the money.
Best Columbia we have been to. Fantastic service. Very clean. Staff ensured everything was perfect.

A solid choice for a healthier breakfast with a unique blend of menu items. It's all healthy foods but all of it is super fresh and a fun alternative too Goldy's & Big Coffe Downtown or Joe Momma's in Meridian

The Dandelion is a unique restaurant, I loved the interior of the building and I enjoyed the meal I had. The wait staff was attentive. Overall I had a lovely dining experience and I would go back when in the area.
BEST pancakes I've ever had! Love the waitress, the hostess, the other food. Great time!

Give this place a try. We are lucky to have them in Boise. Owners are friendly and service was great. We will definitely  
   be coming back. We were looking for a great pho spot and I think we found it.

If it was possible to give less than one star I would. My boyfriend and I started coming to Movie Tavern after our friends introduced it to us when Sully came out in 2016. We loved the concept, and the service was excellent. Over the last two years unfortunately this place has gotten worse and worse each time we come. We began noticing the ticket printing machines were always broken, the menu changed (the wine selections for the worse) and the service was really poor. We finally hit our breaking point when we came to see Endgame this past Saturday night. They made everyone wait in the lobby until 9:45 (the time the movie was supposed to start) because they were still "cleaning the theater". Everyone began pouring into the theater during the previews which is supposed to be the time that orders are taken and food and drinks are being delivered so that it doesn't disrupt the movie once it starts. Our waitress looked miserable and like she didn't want to be there and treated us as much. We ordered a beer and a glass of wine. After 1 hour and 45 minutes when we STILL had not received our drinks, I rang my button for our waitress (which I NEVER do) and she told me she would check on it. It took her another 25 minutes to bring the drinks. She apologized but never offered to comp one of the drinks since they came out SUPER late or offer any type of explanation for it. 
We paid $16.50 per ticket for a movie we will have to watch again at another theater because of all the distraction

It's decent. Went in a Thursday, no wait time. Inside the place looks very nice, they also have dehydrated towelettes. We got the signature 12 course, which means 12 pieces of fancy assembled sushi which were pretty cool and fairly tasty. Don't expect to be full after eating here, it's more for the experience. Kind of wish our server could have gone into a bit more detail on the sushi and the background of omakase. Won't come again until my income is higher, but if you want to try it once i would recommend here!

Always a delicious choice for lunch! Fresh, flavorful and filling.  Skip the pita sandwich and go with the bowl as they come with fresh pita anyway. Just stuff the bowl in the pita and eat- best of both worlds. Will be back.
Darn good traditional burger.  Other menu choices looked great.  And they gave Mexican Coke.

Wow! The best filet in town! Sunday had a perfect brunch and ordered Eggs Benedict. I'm very particular because  this is my favorite breakfast. Then i looked on Yelp and the reviews were awful. Please give this place another chance. They have a new manager and working hard to change . The best Southern pie in. Logan's goodbye..lol

We love the food and the ambiance here!! We had the 3 course meal.  For some reason I selected the onion tart- I hate onions!!! I think their ghost prompted me to order- because it  is FANTASTIC!! Light and sweet- so different from what I expect from onions.  The pasta with shrimp (it's been a while-so I forget the names) was presented beautifully and delicious.  The drinks..... omg so good.   There were 4 of us and not one dish was not over the top excellent!
Meh...nice atmosphere but food was mediocre, especially for the price.  Calamari was a small portion and the texture of paper inside.  Clams and uovo pizza were decent but not great.

One of the best two meals of my life! I've come here on vacation twice in the last two years and both times I was met with world class service and food. Most recently, I had the Sea Bass and the Lobster Lasagnette. Both were perfectly done and flavorful. Definitely recommend those along with the lemoncello cocktail and the tiramisu. Waitress was Liz and she was amazingly polite, funny and non intrusive. Easy 5 stars.

Mac And cheese used to be the absolutely most delicious mac & cheese anywhere in Reno, Now sadly to say it's noodles with a wee bit of cheese and if your lucky a little bit of bacon Thrown in. I cannot recommend this anymore

Cute little spot with really nice staff!  I loved the size of the cupcakes and the bundle options.  I'm gonna be real and say that the cupcake flavors that I had besides the chocolate options were not anything to write home about.  The chocolate brownie bar is the bomb and so is the Rocky Rock cupcake.  The other options we had were just okay. We had the cheescake bar,  coconut, caramel apple, and pecan pie cupcake.  Cheescake tasted like the fridge and the rest were bland.  I wanted to love this place so bad!  I'll def be back for the chocolate bar and frozen sangria/rose blend.  The other flavors need a little work. You have you have one attempt... one bite... to really hit me with the flavor.  Some minor adjustments there and this place would be awesome!
Kaitlyn is THE BEST bartender!!!  Such a great atmosphere and always great bands!  Love us some Barefoot Fiddler and Nudies!

Stopped in here for a coffee and dessert after a day of tooling around Jackson Square. I did the sketch during my visit as it is chocked with character. A very small place and we were fortunate to get a table by the window. Server was super friendly and funny. Prices are med hi for the offerings but overall a great experience.

Nice atmosphere in the restaurant. Nice selection on the menu. The crab cheesecake sounds nasty but tastes absolutely delicious!!! my husband I shared one but I could've had a slice all to myself! It actually would've been lovely as a main too. Also fresh warm bread for the table was nice. For entrees, I had the seared scallops and risotto, it was perfect! scallops cooked to perfection, good portion sizes and very tasty!! My husband had some fish which he said he enjoyed. For dessert, I felt slightly disappointed. I had the chocolate torte cheesecake, and it was very heavy and rich, and also very hard! Pieces of it was flying across the room when you 'cut' into it.. it was so hard it was more like sawing into it. The description mentioned chocolate mousse so I expected a light and airy chocolate cheesecake but it was dense and sickly. Serving this with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or some raspberry coulis would've helped it slightly. My husband ordered the bread pudding, while it was delicious, we seemed to have been served a child's portion, it was barely a slither, almost as flat as the plate itself whereas the next table had full, thick cake slices.

It's a shame when the whole meal was so good but let down by the final experience of dessert. 
I would come here again but order different desserts.

A decent spot for lunch. Good prices and menu variety. I have always liked their sandwiches. Most recently, I ordered their you-pick-two combo with an orchard salad and tomato basil soup. The soup was pretty delicious with garlic bread on the side and a swirl of pesto sauce on the top. The salad was good in theory, but the greens were sparse and wilty. I also asked if they had a balsamic vinaigrette, and the cashier told me yes. But my food was delivered with no dressing at all, so I grabbed some oil and balsamic vinegar off the condiment bar. That's fine but not the same as a vinaigrette.

The restaurant was super busy around 1 p.m. The staff was pretty nice but seemed to be having trouble keeping up. Almost every table was dirty and we waited a while for our lunches, which were both soups and salads, and I'd think a lot of that is premade (i.e., nothing needing to be cooked.) I'd return but would probably come at a less busy time and stick with soups or sandwiches.

Amazing food and wonderful owners.   My husband and I stopped there this afternoon as we were taking our special needs son out for a ride.   They each had the pulled pork platters and they couldn't have been happier.  I had the Rib Snack and it was soooo good.   Will definitely be back!

It's clear that Kobe Steakhouse is literally a well-oiled machine, as the host, servers, and hibachi chefs were completely in sync with each other. We were seated and immediately asked our drink orders, and shortly after our appetizers and meal orders were taken. Exit host, enter hibachi chef for the main show. Everything was delivered in a very timely manner and the food was absolutely phenomenal. Tyson, our hibachi chef, was hilarious and had the whole table laughing. My wife had the teriyaki chicken, I had the steak teriyaki, and we shared a lobster rangoon. Wow- mouth-watering and savory stuff! The perfect spot for our 10th wedding anniversary- we loved it. Plenty of extras along the way- the flying shrimp, soup, and salad too! Go here- you won't be disappointed!

SERVICE IS TRASH. Never in my life have I ever been disrespected anywhere I've ever been to to go eat. I'm the type to tip accordingly. That means if the service wasn't that great, I won't go out of my way. The last time I've been here, I tipped my guy $15 because he was great. The lady I dealt with this most recent visit talked to me once and it was on a slow day so it wasn't busy or anything. When I went to pay, I tipped her $5. I didn't feel like it was that bad of a tip for a lunch meal. I mean it could've been worse where I didn't tip at all. She made it very clear she was unhappy about it and started speaking in Chinese holding the $5 to her coworker being snarky. Rude. If you didn't want it you could give it back. It's free money on you and you guys charge a mandatory $39 to assist customers by cooking their food so what is the real problem here? The food isn't even all that great. For all this, I could've gone to Nine Ting in Philly which is another all you can eat hot pot and their service is way better and there's more variety so you can kiss my ass.

I have live, FULL TIME on Clearwater Beach, for 10 years. Recently, Tan's Chinese switched Owners. Was told on several attempts for delivery of food over the last 2 months (Feb-Mar '19), " we don't deliver to North Clearwater Beach! And just tonight, I tried to do a pickup order, NO PORK served at Tan's Chinese Restaurant! WTF. (I threw their take out menu in garbage & will NEVER again order from them or try to). SAD! (Clearwater Beach local - full time).

Overall golfing experience fun but food didn't arrive until we were basically ready to leave. Also they got rid of the impossible meat for Vegans . Wish the service was fast because I'm starving. They did make me some really good bread though and I appreciated that.

Hungry. Took over 1 hour for the steak nachos!! And at least 40 minutes for tator tots. 

Food was delicious though and drinks were good.

The food here is delicious, as is the coffee; which is a shame as I will not come here again until the staff takes the ongoing global pandemic seriously. Out of five staffers I personally encountered, only one was wearing a mask. One other had their mask looped around one ear - why even bother at all?

Yikes!  I had read the positive reviews of Etch which is what drew me in.  Ed was our server.  One word: Terrific
Ed knew the menu inside out which was valuable.  Ed was great and super service oriented.  The menu was really interesting.  The chef is very talented.  Each dish is complicated yet simple.  By that I mean that the ingredients are many and really interesting and yet you know whet you're ordering.  Etch is a big winner.  You will enjoy it.

We went for a birthday dinner and were no impressed.  So many things were off.  Service was good but not great.  We felt like they kept trying to rush us. My husband doesn't like seafood and all the appetizers but one were seafood.  A kids menu is provided but not many young children eat steak.  The menu didn't offer a lot of choices. For us it wasn't an issue since our daughter is 12.  Everything is al a cart which drives up the prices.  Cesar salad was great.  The drinks were great.  I ordered the petite filet and my husband ordered the rib eye.  We both asked for medium well.  His was well done and mine was medium.  They took mine back to the kitchen and it was so hot I couldn't eat it for 10min.  They should have e redone the steak.  Think this happens often since server wasn't surprised.  If you're charging $45-$55 for steaks they should be flavorful and cooked as requested.  The steaks were bland.  The highlight of my meal was the asparagus.  Dessert was ok but not small and not great.  We won't be back and will continue to go to Berns.

This restaurant exceeded all of my expectations (I'm from NYC, so my expectations are really high ‍) from service to drinks and food. A must if you are in Indy. The menu is off the beaten path with inusual flavor pairings that surprisingly feel like heaven in your mouth. The wait is the only negative thing, we waited 1hr to be seated, but that was during peak hours on a Sunday (12:00pm) so the earlier you get, the fastest you get seated. 

Decor- 4 out of 5
Service- 5 out of 5
Price- 4 out of 5- but worth every penny
Food Quality- 5 out of 5
Drinks- 4 out of 5

Alright...if you want to know how this compares to other Thai restaurants in Tampa... ya' got it. It's the BEST THAI EVER!!! 

Why? Well, let's start with the ingredients- it's fresh and everything is homemade (from the soup broth to the curry paste) and there is not a lick of MSG in it!

Ambience - it's like being in Thailand and eating outside with a family friendly staff. There is no language barrier there as Glen is American. His wife is the sweetest lady that you will ever meet!

The soup was the most authentic soup we had and the grapow was fantabulous!

I don't give many yelp reviews but this one deserves more than a raving review. If you are looking to have real authentic Thai food, do yourself a favor and order from Thaimama!

I really wanted to like this place better than I did.  A couple of positives--the service was amazing.  I really like the atmosphere, too.

The mediocre--my meal.  I got the breaded tenderloin, which I'd heard good things about.  I found it to be quite bland, and all the breading slid off the meat pretty much immediately, so I was left with a pork tenderloin sandwich and a plate full of breading.  I chose onion rings as my side, and the were considerably burnt.  (Like--I'm no chef, but I would have been ashamed to have let them out of MY kitchen)

That said, some others in our party had different meals and they looked amazing, and they were all quite pleased with what they got.  Although I was disappointed in my meal, the atmosphere and service make it so I'll return.

With the pandemic, I'm hoping the world class chef they just hired is not available because the breakfast this morning pretty much sucked.  Didn't take any photos, because... well.... IHOP could have done a better job.  $50 for a schitty breakfast.   Not at all worth it.  My compote fresh toast didn't boast any mascarpone or PA related maple syrup.... and my wife's omelette was lacking flair!
Will try again this evening to get a drink and see how they do.  Will keep you posted.  

Cheers!!

I wouldn't expect a coffee shop to have good Bahn mi but do not underestimate Brown street! Definitely my go-to bahn mi place whenever I'm having a hankering for it. The bread is wonderful and flaky, and the fillings are nicely flavored. I've tried the pork and tofu and both are terrific. Aside from the great bahn mi, coffee is solid (Stumptown coffee!) and the breakfast sandwiches do not disappoint (get the brioche if you want to indulge!).

Second time... We love this place. Great menu, friendly service, great music, comfortable atmosphere, great prices and specials!! Try it and you'll be glad you did. Excellent beer selection?, amazing salads and burgers, yummy fried pickles, etc. Kids eat free, too, on Tuesdays!! We'll make the trip back from Hendersonville.

OBSESSED. My new favorite place. Austin was my waiter and he was so kind & really cared about us to make sure our experience was great. He was so friendly & sweet. Had a filet, Brussels sprouts, & potstickers. Everything was AMAZING. I am picky on my steaks and it was literally the best steak I've ever had. It was so juicy & cooked to perfection. The Brussels sprouts were so good, seasoned with Parmesan cheese and bacon- love. The potstickers were OUTSTANDING. Everything was amazing & the service was so good.

We ordered in tonight instead of going out. We just got a simple supreme pizza and my friend got a salad. The pizza was good as far as pizza goes but very undercooked. Very dough-y but we still ate it because we were hungry. My friend started eating her salad to find a piece of RAW bacon inside. She almost ate that. We are not happy.

Holy cow!  Went here on Super Bowl Sunday because everything else was closed. The Hollandaise and Bacon fires were AMAZING!  I had the ribs with a salad. Salad was very fresh. Ribs were fall of the bone tender. My husband had a bacon burger. He said it was excellent and bacon was freshly cooked. Drinks were good.
Only giving 2 stars cause the French toast wasn't bad and my server was great but my food was cold and pretty bad

We just had the tacos- al pastor and the chorizo and they were out of the world. We had both kinds - with the sour cream and without. I liked the one without- more authentic and flavorful. Can't wait to go back and try some of their platters!
Not wearing masks until they see the customers arriving to pick up their food order. Unacceptable!

Nice little place in Keswick village. Portione are very generous, prices are reasonable. Chicken gyro platter and dolmades are my favorites.. Inside is a quintessential Greek restaurant. They even have a small Greek grocery section for specialty items.

Got the order wrong, floor was terribly sticky, bathrooms were gross. We were only customers in there, manager was sitting down, so I don't think they were too busy to keep it clean. Food was nothing special, icees were sub par

I got veggie burrito with spinach, quinoa, corn, beans, and pick de Gallo on whole wheat wrap. Very good and healthy. Wrap is soft and flavor is on point. I took a star down because I realized that according to the menu it comes with salad but I didn't get salad. I had mine to go. Also I tried to substitute spinach with romaine but I was told that I couldn't so I said to omit it. When o got my order there's spinach in it. 

My husband had shrimp tacos. He said it's good and the shrimp is huge. 

I was lucky to ask for flan and they had it. It's pretty good with enough sweetness and nice density. It comes with strawberries and blueberries.

We've stopped coming here. It used to be one of our favorites but they're just let us down too many times recently. The last time we came here, the manager gave us a dirty look when we came in with our three kids (who are actually really quiet and well behaved in restaurants) and huffed at us when we asked for a high chair.  
Service was less than stellar too. Nobody stopped by to give us menus for several minutes, and we had to ask for silverware after our meals finally arrived. It was just a constant series of little oversights like this from beginning to end and I never once felt welcomed.
One bad visit I could understand but it's been a pattern lately. 

We've switched to the Colonial, and they're not perfect but at least they don't treat us like we're intruding on them.
Ordered the kale crush and I saw the lady making it pouring pineapple juice from a Dole can that has been sitting on the counter! I don't know how that is supposed to B GOOD? never again

One of Tucson's best local businesses! They have all types of sandwiches, salads, soups, mac and cheese available as well as bakes goods, fresh breads, beer, and wine. This is a frequently visited place with my friends and family as we all love it and are able to get different things for everyone. We always get a loaf or two to go for home as well as a few baked goodies.
Fun experience! The service is really good at this location. We love sitting at the booths and their loaded hash brown bowls.

This place used to be the best burger in the New Tampa area but since the original owner left it's totally tanked.  We went in for lunch and didn't see a single face we recognize. Order taker was wearing a mask but the guy cooking and handling our food wasn't and seemed more interested in talking to the girls than preparing our order. Someone came from the back room who we assumed was the manager, mask hanging off one ear and began cooking something for what appeared to be himself given that no one else was in the place. It became joke time with him and the cook.  Food was subpar at best. Waited 25 minutes and $17 for a patty melt and order of fries. The fries were greasy and could taste oil. The patty melt was simply not good, greasy, lacking flavor and you would have thought grilled onions ware at a premium since there were hardly any on the sandwich.  They seem to be getting away from what they used to do best and trying to offer Italian dishes too. They've lost focus. You'll be happier going to Wendy's for half the price. Yes

Cody's is our favorite place for Sunday dinner. We usually get one of the four $10.98 Sunday specials which comes with endless salad, rolls & cinnamon butter, green beans & one side, and dessert. We always have enough food to feel full & we bring home the dessert and some leftovers. The salad with signature dressing is fresh and delicious. Our favorite entrée is the Country Fried Pork Steak, but the half chicken is always good, and almost always offered. The variety of sides makes choosing difficult since all are good. Usually the dessert is chocolate cake, but today it was blueberry cheesecake. Yummy! The service is also efficient, personable, and timely. We highly recommend Cody's!

Amazing plethora of Vegan topping options. We got vegan sausage, artichoke, spinach and vegan cheese. Cooked perfectly and absolutely delicious! Staff was super nice. So happy to see that Boise has more vegan options.

We love this part sandwich shop & part Italian restaurant. We have enjoyed the times we've been in for dinner & look forward to making it in for lunch some time to try their sandwiches. The chicken parmesan & creamy basil pesto sauce over linguini is so good & the Hay Hay special is just as tasty I'm told (can't try due to shrimp allergy). These are so good we haven't been been able to try other main courses.  We have tried the mussels and wow we almost had to play rock paper scissors over the last one. The caprese was perfect for sharing and the balsamic so good.  And the garlic bread is yummy. Sadly we've not left room for desert but the options sound so good.
This place is amazing! The ambiance, the service and the food were all outstanding. I came here with my mother for a mother/daughter date and we'll be back for lunch tomorrow :)

Very mediocre. Had never been here before and the hummus, doner sandwich and other dish we had weren't particularly well spiced. The fries were also extremely burnt! Hopefully it was just an off night.

Gave the place a try last night.  There were two people inside the bar running one of those door-to-door "sweepstakes sales" scams, one of whom was high or something and who kept verbally and physically harassing my wife and I (swearing, threatening to fight us if we didn't buy something, etc).  Management comped our drinks but did not ask the panhandlers to leave, so we left.  We will not be coming back.

In no way, shape or form am I a fan on meatballs. But boy do I love Mimi Blue Meatballs.  One things do enjoy is a good Brussel sprout and this place has what might be the city's best.

I came to taste these delectable selections due to a work provided lunch and I've been a fan ever since.  Their turkey meatballs with the honey sriracha sauce are fantastic! Couple with the Brussels sprouts and Mac and queso, mmm mmm!

I have not had the privilege of dining in yet but the layout inside is certainly inviting. The vibe from the decor gives a welcoming conversational atmosphere without too much pomp.

The takeout service has met expectation. Overall no complaints at all. If you haven't been, check them out.

Ordered on the night of 10-18-2019 
Horrible to go service 
The girls on the phone were too busy talking to each other to listen to my order 
They had a horrible attitude
Took forever to actually process my simple order 
When I arrived at the pickup parking they had an even worse attitude in person even though I was polite 
Once I got home and tried to eat the food my family and I thought it was horrible 
Wings were so dry 
Food was flavorless 
Sandwich on the wrong type of bread  
Shrimp had barely any sauce on it, flavorless 
Gave them another chance but I am never returning to this place ever again and will not recommend to anyone.

Friendly staff! The proprietor is wonderful, very sweet and attentive! Five stars right there... wonderful lady!

I love Mexican food. I grew up in Texas, and have lived in Colorado and New Mexico. I have spent probably a year in various parts of Mexico, eating traditional foods. I also love to cook Mexican food... usually because I have trouble finding restaurants that have not overly Americanized their recipes.

The meal tonight reminded me of some the restaurants I ate at as a boy growing up. Very much like the food I have had in El Paso and in Juarez, Mx.  Delicious. 

I had the signature dish.. Enchiladas with green tomatillo sauce and shredded chicken. Nicely done! Very tasty. I also ordered Cheese Chile Relleno (I love them) and I find them to be a good gauge of how the the food is cooked. The rellenos I grew up with were made with a traditional fluffed egg white batter, that has a distinctive taste... especially when fried in lard. It was very good. Refritos (beans) were good. Spanish rice was bland... but a little salt and some of the hot sauces fixed it right up.

Complimentary chips and salsa rojo were brought to the table while we were looking at the menus. Chips appeared to be freshly made, hot... and still a little greasy as good chips should be. The salsa had a wonderful flavor (appears to also be made in house), and was not spicy at all (so anyone can enjoy it. 

The proprietor asked me if I wanted some hot sauces that they make... and I said yes. She brought

Took forever for the bar maid to acknowledge me and my friend. She was focused on watching the tv and playing in her hair.  It wasn't even crowded at the bar - six people at the bar. I finally came here after my friends ranted and raved about this place. It took 30 minutes for someone to come take my food order. I ordered calamari and it took 25 minutes to get to me. When they arrived, they looked like bloated Cheerios that had been over fried. I'm good on this place. Not worth the hype...

Mercato is family during these tuff times! Was in the area one last time for work and picked up a late lunch/early dinner for the family (Family Dinner pick up option!).

We ate up everything in their italian dinner, laughed about the Flintstone's episode about "Meatballs that don't bounce", and just had a good homestyle comforting Italian dinner.

Definitely will do this again soon/routinely, if you're looking for some Italian to pick up over the next couple months, highly recommend going to this place, ESPECIALLY while parking was free and convenient since the meter's are temporarily suspended.

Just had the most amazing lunch!
Our waitress Natalie helped with the menu which was great.
Our daughter just moved here so this restaurant is on our list for a repeat!
Might even have to come back before we leave town.
Thank you!

Dont recommend for call ahead take out orders. I called to place an order, they said it would be an hour. I get to the restaurant and they couldn't find my order. Their remedy was saying I had to now wait after every other order and wait my turn.

This is a great sushi place. We have eaten here several times but we got takeout this evening and they had a good Covid system in place. We ordered for carry out and paid over the phone. When I arrived to pick up our order it was bagged and waiting in the entryway. The sign said to sign the credit card receipt and leave it in the jar sitting next to the sign. There was hand sanitizer there as well.
There was a little confusion when I checked the order bc I ordered crab Rangoon and didn't see what I expected. Turns out their crab Rangoon is a delicious crab Rangoon sushi roll. 
The order was right, the food was delicious and ready for pickup in 20min.
If you like sushi, give this place a try!
Stevie hooked us up with a bar spot and a hot cup of coffee for the Liverpool game this morning!  She was awesome!  What a great way to spend the morning at Chatham Tap.  Thank you Stevie!
So worth the visit! Really fun atmosphere. Our waiter Gaspar was fabulous! We love Drunken Fish's sushi menu. Fun evening out and terrific food. 5 stars!

We came here for the burgers after a night out in the French Quarter.  We got in and were seated right away.  In addition, our order was taken within a few minutes.  The burgers and baked potato were both very good.  The burgers were large, juicy, and cooked to perfection.  The baked potato was buttery and cooked well (I added sour cream and chives to mine).  The drinks (iced tea and lemonade) were served in large, to-go souvenir cups. The vibe of the bar was very friendly.  Overall, an excellent experience!  Good food, good service, and reasonable prices.
Best tacos around!   Never have ordered anything we didn't like.  Amazing flavor and great fresh toppings

Went on a Saturday evening, around 5pm. We initially were pleasantly surprised they could seat us right away, but later realized this was because they were filling every table. Service was slow, food and sides were lukewarm when served. We've been here previously and their sides for the BBQ options were more limited and lower quality. Server told us two sides were included, yet on the bill we were up-charged. Never given the coleslaw that was part of the BBQ combo. Waters never refilled. We've been to a bunch of Media restaurants during the COVID dining modifications this was the first and only place we've felt disappointed in service and uncomfortably crowded.
Top 10 in NOLA and very underutilized. If you're visiting, and you appreciate good French food, don't miss it!
The atmospheres is so chill and relaxed for a big party. The tacos are next level at this spot. The mango salsa and toppings on the tacos make them so fresh!!!

I loved the atmosphere here! I was looking for a good spot to work for a few hours without being "monitored" - and I found it! I love the ambiance and setup. There was seating inside and outside (despite it being in a strip mall type setting.) I will definitely be back!

Did a take out order and all the food we ordered was bland except the egg flower soup. Ordered the house special fried rice and Kung Pao chicken. Both items barely and any meat in them mostly vegetables or rice. The white rice that came with the kung pao was soggy and mushy. Will not be trying again.

Been here for Happy Hour at least 10 times if not more since 2016. The last two times I've come I've noticed a decrease in their food quality (specifically, the pizza). Also, I'm not sure why but current lineup of waitresses / hostesses have seemed perturbed or maybe not as friendly as they used to be a few years ago. This most recent stop was my 'giving them one more chance' visit and looks like it'll be the last. Their beer is great, so still worthy of three stars.
4.5 overall. They messed up on our last order and my 6yr old had to wait for his burger while the rest of the family ate :/ food wise ITS GOOD!

We were excited to try Whiskey Cake and made a reservation for 11:00am, the time they open.  We got to the restaurant right at 11:00 and the door was locked.  We could see the hostess through the glass on the side of the front door; she appeared to be on the phone.  We thought "No problem, she sees us and when the call is over she'll greet and seat us."  Well, when she was done, she stepped away.  At about 11:05 or so an employee who appeared to be a server (late for work) walked quickly by without acknowledging us.  Surely he'd mention to someone that there were two customers standing out front?  The hostess came back, I tried the door again: it was still locked.  Still no acknowledgement.  We checked Open Table and Whiskey Cake's own website to confirm that they did in fact open at 11:00.  It wasn't until 11:12 the bartender came out to the bar area.  I asked her if they were open, she looked at her watch and said yes, and that she'd get someone.  At 11:13 the doors were unlocked and a server explained that everyone had been in a pre-shift meeting.  At this point we were no longer interested in dining at Whiskey Cake and I advised we were going to eat somewhere else.
 
I know stuff happens and maybe the meeting ran long, but if a business opens at 11:00 the door should be unlocked at that time and surely one employee could be spared to greet and seat customers.  We would have been fine to just sit and look at the menu, especially since this was someplace new for us.  I'd th

My husband and I returned for a Valentine's weekend stay and every little thing was impeccable! The last time we were here was 5 months ago for our wedding - the wedding was fabulous, but service was spotty. What a difference 5 months has made, as the team here completes the transition into the Marriot family. This stay we opted for Club access, which is an incredible value, and staff here is above and beyond. 

This is a unique, gorgeous property. It also holds a special place in our hearts, being the place where we got engaged and got married. This stay truly solidified it as a mainstay in our lives, and a place we will be marking many a special occasion. Thank you for the continued memories!
We had an amazing meal here for my father in law's 70th birthday! The food was stellar and service was just wonderful. Can't wait to go back!

This may be my new favorite spot, I came here for my Birthday. The staff (our waiter Nick) was friendly and attentive,  the food was tasty and the drinks good. I had the vanilla Paloma(?) and a lemon drop very tasty.  The food pictured was delicious we also had the the mac and cheese and shrimp salad.  No complaints. We all hope to return soon for brunch.
Love the adename hummus app! The rice meals are delicious as well. Never had a rice or sushi meal I didn't like. More upscale atmosphere but decent happy hours. Will go again!

Nice Friday night spot. I was impressed with our server Phil's ability to remember orders for six people...
Download their app and use it for a FREE appetizer.
I had a Ribeye steak that was very tasty...just a little more done than I wanted...but still very good. Green beans were good too!

This place is a joke.
I tried to get takeout from this Olive Garden three different times within three different weeks. And I didn't get take out any time. The first time I called at 8 o'clock they told me they could have my to go order ready at 9:30. What?? No other place is making you have reservations on takeout. So passed on that considering I was only in the area for a little bit. Called a few days later to make an order. Wanted to order salmon piccata was told they don't have any. OK chicken piccata. They don't have that either. In fact, they have almost nothing. So, nope. Not ordering. Called a few days ago to order dessert at 8:15. They close at nine. I am told that they stop doing to go orders already. It's 815 and you close at nine and you're not doing takeout orders anymore?!

Each time I got off the phone with Olive Garden I got to go from Carabbas with no issue.
How you treat your customers during this time says a lot about your character. And this Olive Garden failed me three times so I'm done. I haven't been to this trash restaurant in almost 3 years and I can guarantee you it'll be another three years. I hope you lose a lot of business for the way you're acting right now to customers.

Had lunch here a few days ago.  Delicious as always!
So happy to have City Limits nearby
So impressed! We ordered delivery via GrubHub and the food arrived hot. It was authentic, well spiced, and delicious.

Worst Chick-fil-A I have ever been to across the country. Not all the staff is rude, but the managers are. They got upset with ME when my order came out incorrectly. I waited 20 mins for my order then an extra 15 mins for a cold fry. This franchise is known for their customer service but this location has zero. I'd drive out of the way to avoid this place.
This pizza is cracker thin. Actually its much thinner. Its saint Louis pizza at its finest. I always get pepperoni.

One of my favorite sushi spots. Fast and friendly service along with amazing and delicious sushi! I have been coming here a few times a year for the past 3 years and they have never let me down. Thank you Kei Sushi!

They literally have the best fries I've ever eaten! The staff is always super friendly and the owner is very nice. The food is always good and consistent and the $6 burger special on Wednesday is a great deal.

Been here multiple times for breakfast and everyone left happy. The food is awesome and the selections of unique blends of coffees and teas are a plus. Service is fast and the servers are friendly. There are some vegetarian options and so far have yet to be disappointed.

Sat on balcony in early Oct for a birthday celebration.  Very good service and super variety menu.  Seafood Gumbo was very good.  Oyster appetizer and crab legs good.  BBQ shrimp and grits good.  
Consistently good place to go

I happened upon this place while staying in the area for a few days, so I stopped by for lunch. I decided to order it to go, but the waitress was very kind and offered me something to drink while I waited for my meal to be ready. I ordered the rice bowl and it came with a side, so I chose the Mac 'n cheese. The sauce for the rice bowl is a little spicy, so I had it on the side, but it was delicious! Kale is a good leafy green to go with the all of the ingredients, but the dish turned out more like a salad than I had anticipated. It didn't incorporate well with the white rice, fried egg and sautéed broccoli, so maybe if the kale had been chopped up into smaller pieces or even lightly sautéed, I think it would have mixed better with the rest of the ingredients. The Mac 'n cheese was amazing! Loved it. A little in the pricy side, but the food tasted fresh, and they also have vegan and gluten free options on the menu.

Horrible service!!!!   We were seated and provided our menus.  We sat and sat and sat!!!  30 minutes went by with one person even looking at us.  I tried to get someone's attention and they looked at me and said we'll be right with you and walked away.  They continued to serve others that came well after we did.  Finally we got up and left.  I DON'T THINK THEY EVEN KNEW WE WERE THERE!!!!!!!  WILL NOT GO BACK!!!!!!!!!

One word- Terrible!
We thought we would try a new pizza place, and read great reviews. 

Pizza was called in for take out, sausage,  green peppers,  mushrooms,  extra crispy. 

The employees were not following proper mask wearing, and pizza was so greasy,  crust was soggy, and it was inedible. 

Immediately thrown in the garbage. 

We will never order anything from that place again.

And, a future name change won't improve product.
Terrible!

I ordered online the Special Grande Family Meal, and the service was pretty good, i even got the sauces i asked for unlike some other pollo tropical locations. Although the service was great, they forgot a part of my order (Mojo Pork) and they didn't answer the phone. We passed by here as we were on our way to a city that didn't have a pollo tropical location so we couldn't do anything when we got home. Pretty dissapointed.

Update: The owner actually contacted me and gave me a compensation to make up for the mistake. It's nice that they read these reviews and keep customer satisfaction a priority. It was a really pleasant surprise. Thank you!

I had their pizza (and their gluten-free pizza years ago. Both were horrible. Mushy crust. Terrible flavor. Decided to try again tonight. Ordered Insalata Di Frutti Di Mare$16.99
calamari, shrimp and jumbo lump crabmeat on a bed of greens, tossed with lemon olive oil, garlic and parsley. There was a lot of totally plain, unseasoned seafood on top of a romaine lettuce salad. The "dressing", which I asked for and got on the side, was a container of olive oil. No garlic flavor whatsoever. No trace of lemon. No sign of parsley anywhere. The seafood was fresh. That was the single good thing about it. It was all tasteless and hugely disappointing. And the garlic bread is even worse. It appeared to be some kind of strangely orange-colored spread on a flattened hoagie roll. Terrible flavor and texture. Didn't taste like there was any butter involved whatsoever. Didn't taste like Parmesan. Slight flavor of plastic, prefab, industrial garlic. Horrible. I'm sorry that I gave them a second chance after all these years. There are too many other Italian restaurants around to waste $ at this one. Husband said there was a line out the door. I'll never got the life of me understand what people see in this establishment.

I've eaten here a few times. Each time the pizza is good but not great. I can't seem to put my finger on it but maybe the sauce turns me off. The staff is always friendly and attentive. 

Give it a try and let me know your thoughts.

I don't know how this place is getting such bad ratings. Growing up in an Indiana suburb of Chicago with an Italian grandmother I know good Italian when I see it & this is it! The salad was amazing with super fresh ground pepper that the waitress ground right in front of us. The homemade meatballs and homemade sausage were so soft. The sauce with the sausage and penne was spicy and fresh. Service was quick. The decorations were very similar to Italian households and restaurants I had been to back home. And the company was great! All of the staff wished us a Merry Christmas on our way out. Glad I ignored the lower ratings and listened to coworkers' recommendations to go here.

It should be illegal to spend a Friday lunch like I did today at  Frosty Boy in New Palestine - dipping onion chips in catsup and cooling down with some strawberry whip! 

#Getlostindiana 

You just don't #find places like this much anymore...

We had been looking for good NY style pizza for a while, and this place is exactly what we were looking for... the pizza is authentic, delicious, and reasonably priced. (The garlic knots are also delicious.)
Excellent pizza, always made fresh and delivered hot. Their subs and hoagies are excellent too. Good prices. This is definitely my go-to pizza joint and I order from them about once a week.

We stepped in for lunch on Christmas Eve and were pleasantly surprised by the crowd, decor, vibe and food. They had a separate vegetarian menu available, giving more options. 

We started off with a platter of char-grilled oysters, which I enjoyed since I don't prefer them raw. That being said, the flavors of the cheese overpowered the dish. I went for the pick 2 for 12.95 from the lunch menu- a blue crab bisque soup and a shrimp po'boy half. The bisque was creamy, rich and flavorful - amazing!! The po'boy was great as well. Ordered the dessert of the day, which completed my meal.  

Service was great. Definitely a good choice to get a taste of NOLA.

This is a great brunch/lunch place. It can have the reputation of being a health food place, but don't let that turn you off. Everything is really good and there are lots of options depending on what you're in the mood for. They do a cute mimosa bucket with little bottles of champagne that's fun with friends. The location is really nice and I like that you can sit outside if the weather is nice.
This place is our go to when we want Chicago deep dish or thin crust.  Order well done and don't cut on the deep dish.  We lived in Chicago for 10 years prior to moving here.

Great food. I always carry out from here. Whether it's single plates or large party trays the pasta is always cooked well. Not soggy and over sauced. The sandwiches are good, they will get a little soggy if you do carry out but they're still great.

Beautiful atmosphere...loved the prime rib sandwich at Harry & Izzys and thought I was getting the same thing here....noooo...no great slices of beef.just one hunk of fatty meat...sorry Lounge..know you're new...keep trying...

Had an absolutely amazing evening celebrating my daughter's 14th bday. The food was flavorful, attentive service, and relaxed atmosphere. One of Philly's few remaining hidden gems! Be sure to support!

This poutine is made in my dreams. No complaints, except that I could not finish it. This was perfect for an overcast day. 

Savory pork. Cheese curds for days. Brown gravy that honestly is some of the best I've had. Fries that were as perfectly cooked as you would wish for. Finished with green onion. When you got it all in one bite...it was perfect. The end. I can't say anything else EXCEPT go try them!!

Food is pretty good, not spectacular. The service is not great, always too few people working during busy times. To go service is absolutely terrible- they rarely even answer the phone. They also randomly decide on some nights that they just aren't going to take to go orders. Overall, it's pretty average. Way better places out there.

Absolutely fantastic food! I had the shrimp and lobster pork and it was amazing! Shrimp cooked to perfection! Not rubbery or undercooked. I'm from Michigan and I know a thing or two about good Chinese food and it's not by putting peas and carrots in every damn thing! No! This food was full of flavor and bursting with taste. My new go to place! Why did I wait so long? I have no idea.

Overhyped. Steaks are good, though strange that a "medium well" steak here is 100% well done with no pink at all. It was still tender enough to eat, but the medium my dad got was more on the medium rare side so I have no idea how you can get actually get a medium well steak here. The French Onion soup was the best I've ever had, salad was lackluster & the macadamia vanilla salad dressing tastes kind of like yogurt for those wondering. Vegetables were good. Waiter was nice enough, but when I mentioned we were celebrating my dad's 60th birthday it was like "oh happy birthday". Also didn't check back but like once before we'd even had a chance to taste the food, so I had to wait a long time to ask for more butter.
Place looks like a cross between haunted mansion and a funeral parlor... Decor could definitely use an update. I wouldn't have been surprised at all if a vampire had popped out and started drinking someone's blood 
The dessert room was a better vibe & very unique, but the desserts were nothing amazing. Server there was nice enough.
Final thoughts: stupid to have to pay for parking at a restaurant like this where there is free parking nearby & it isn't in a downtown area (where parking is also often free/cheap here in Tampa)- seems like they're just trying to squeeze a buck out of you wherever they can
Please update your toilets- I haven't seen those gross plastic covers on them since airports 2 decades ago.
Another server in our room was walking around with his nose ou

I have traveled the country since 2013. I've ate Chinese food in San Francisco.  I've ate Italian in NYC. Catfish in Mississippi,  crawfish on the Bayou. BBQ in TX, KC, NC, ATL and many other places. Ate at the great restaurants in Vegas, and all the casinos,  up and down the highways. I even ate BBQ and catfish at the same time at world famous Nick's in Ar.

Tonight,  I took my Lisa to Bascom's Chop house in Clearwater off Ulmerton road in Feather sound. 

It was here that Lisa and I ate the best meal of our lives. 

We were greeted by 2 very nice ladies and immediately taken to our seats. 

Moments later,  our server Tabatha arrived and took our drink orders.

She returned immediately and gave us  a few minutes to ponder our appetizer order. We got  lobster bisk,  artichoke dip with pita chips.  I ordered bread too cause pita chips didn't sound too good to me. I was wrong!!

Bisk was best ever. I could have ate the artichoke dip and the pita chips for ever. Lisa got a salad. Even the salad was delicious.  It came with cured ham, and was layered perfectly. Every bite of the salad was like the first. 

Then the steaks came. OMMFG!!!!!

Lisa got the rib eye and I got the big Porterhouse. Tabatha suggested a marrow truffle butter. Chef Tony is a genius,  because the steak was perfect, and the buttery truffle whatever it was is a taste-bud orgasm for your mouth.

Best meal ever. Best service ever.

Thank you. Thank you, Bascom's for that culinary masterpiece, from start to finis

I'm a somewhat simple man, but I have to say this is one of my favorite meals. They have a Honey Smoked Short Rib Pastrami slider on their small plates menu that's served with a slaw that is just incredibly good.  And I asked the bartender to make a nonalcoholic mock tail and he served up an awesome mixture of basil simple syrup, grapefruit bitters and a splash of cranberry.  Thirst quenching and just the right amount of tang to leave a pleasant aftertaste. 

The best!

My husband and I travel a lot throughout the US and I ALWAYS get camerones al la diabla at each Mexican restaurant I visit. This was hands, down the best I've ever had. It's not currently on the menus but they will make it for you. I will absolutely return to get it again when in the area.

Canyon Cafe offers a casual, comfortable setting for Southwestern recipes inside Plaza Frontenac.  
The three street taco lunch special is a good choice and a good value. Mix or match tacos of seafood, chicken or meat--there's a vegetarian, too. Margarita slaw and chipotle mayonnaise on most pop the flavor.  
Add beans and rice for a couple bucks more.
More complete meals include a variety of salads and entrees of seafood, bison, and chicken. There are even some pasta dishes.
Service has always been attentive during busy lunch periods.
